normalize_state_tensor: normalize a PyTorch state tensor to standard normal distribution using min-max then z-score normalization
unnormalize_state_tensor: unnormalize a PyTorch state tensor back to its original scale from standard normal distribution
normalize_location_tensor: normalize a PyTorch location tensor with shape [..., 2] using hardcoded mean and standard deviation
unnormalize_location_tensor: unnormalize a PyTorch location tensor back to its original coordinates from normalized space
unnormalize_mse_value: unnormalize a mean squared error value by scaling it with the squared mean of location standard deviation
